title: Let the Word transform you
author: Precious Oluwadamilola Oluwasegun
excerpt: Have you ever read a book so captivating that its knowledge keeps you glued to its pages? You find yourself picking it up again and again, rereading lines…
body: Have you ever read a book so captivating that its knowledge keeps you glued to its pages? You find yourself picking it up again and again, rereading lines until they become part of your memory. Over time, you begin to think and act in line with what you've learned.
In the same way, a constant study of the Word of God transforms you. It shapes your thoughts, renews your heart, and produces a visible manifestation that others can see.

Just as the entrance of light eradicates darkness, the illumination of God's Word subdues the flesh. The Word does not merely sit in your heart; it etches itself deep within, bringing light to your entire being.
The Word of God is what sustains your life in Christ. As Jesus said in John 14:15, "If you love Me, keep My commandments." But pause and reflect: can you truly keep a commandment you do not know?
Beloved, head knowledge about God will never be enough. Dive into His Word. Read, meditate, and let it transform you from within.

title: The monkey and the groundnuts
author: Precious Oluwadamilola Oluwasegun
excerpt: In Brazil, capturing a monkey can be surprisingly simple. A bottle filled with groundnuts is hung on a tree. The monkey slips its hand inside easily, but once…
body: In Brazil, capturing a monkey can be surprisingly simple. A bottle filled with groundnuts is hung on a tree. The monkey slips its hand inside easily, but once it grabs the groundnuts, it cannot pull its hand out without letting go. Yet, unwilling to release its prize, the monkey struggles until it is caught.

Sadly, many believers behave the same way, foolish in their thinking. How worldly must you become in order to win a worldly partner? You cling to the pleasures of a worldly relationship, imagining you will not be trapped by the prince of this world. Such reasoning is not only naïve; it is dangerous.

The "groundnuts" you refuse to release are the very things that prevent you from surrendering fully to God. Eventually, they become the cause of spiritual accidents, leading to destruction. Grace cannot abound where sin reigns.
Scripture is clear: friendship with the world is enmity with God. Simple.

title: Only one thing is needful
author: Precious Oluwadamilola Oluwasegun
excerpt: It was never Martha's intention to act contrary to the Lord's desire. All she wanted was to make the Messiah comfortable. Yet the standard of the Lord for…
body: It was never Martha's intention to act contrary to the Lord's desire. All she wanted was to make the Messiah comfortable. Yet the standard of the Lord for His disciples is firm and unwavering.
Jesus said to her: "Martha, Martha, you are worried and anxious about many things; but only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her."

The character of a true disciple is not found in restless activity like Martha's, nor in mere companionship without understanding the Master's perspective, as in the case of Gehazi. The true mark of discipleship lies in seeking to please the Lord, serving Him faithfully, and walking in His path.
Beloved, just one thing is needful. Only one thing. Seek to know the ways of the Lord and follow them. Do not rest in activities or self-righteousness, but in the deep knowledge of Christ.
Seek Him. Serve Him. Follow Him.

title: Chosen to follow
author: Precious Oluwadamilola Oluwasegun
excerpt: Following Jesus requires both leaving behind and stepping forward.
body: Following Jesus requires both leaving behind and stepping forward.
When Jesus called the twelve disciples, He said, "Follow Me." That invitation meant more than walking beside Him; it meant observing His ministry, learning His ways, and becoming like Him.
As a rabbi, Jesus was not expected to wash the feet of His disciples. They were His students; He was their Master. Yet His humble act revealed the true meaning of selflessness and servant leadership.
To become like Christ, you must die to self-gratification and abandon the desire for recognition. A true disciple turns their back on the world and fixes their gaze on the cross.
Discipleship is not mere profession; it is practice. Live it. Act it. Let your light shine before all people.
You have been chosen. Now, walk in it.

title: Launch into the deep
author: Precious Oluwadamilola Oluwasegun
excerpt: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore, get wisdom. And in all your getting, seek understanding. The presence of the Holy Spirit leads us on the path of wisdom…
body: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore, get wisdom. And in all your getting, seek understanding. The presence of the Holy Spirit leads us on the path of wisdom and knowledge, so that we may study to show ourselves approved in every aspect. The Spirit of God is the Spirit of wisdom and of knowledge.

If you are uniquely gifted in your work, you will rise and be promoted. You will not be held back; you will stand before kings! The Lord has given the earth to the sons of men; therefore, you must arise and acquire the knowledge required to conquer the mountain of every industry for His glory.
The entire universe is standing on tiptoe, yearning for the unveiling of God's glorious sons and daughters!

How long will you keep dreaming without taking action toward the realisation of your God-given vision? Success is not for those who sit with folded hands; it is for those willing to give all it takes to succeed.
You have an advantage. You have all you need to stand out. Why then remain idle, doing nothing?
Now is the time to arise. Launch into the deep!

title: False humility
author: Precious Oluwadamilola Oluwasegun
excerpt: Men-pleasers fall into the hideout of false humility. They please men, not God. They dwell on what people will say of them and think of them. They never…
body: Men-pleasers fall into the hideout of false humility. They please men, not God. They dwell on what people will say of them and think of them. They never carry out what God tells them, in the name of humility, a false one, rooted in a sense of inadequacy.

"We are able to go up," Joshua and Caleb declared. Not out of self-sufficiency, but out of a revelation of the God of Jacob that they carried within them. "You uncircumcised Philistine," David declared, "I will give your head to the birds to eat." Upon what premise? "I come to you in the name of the Lord."

Your dressing is okay; don't let a sense of inadequacy make you play God. When Eve ate the fruit, she reached to be like God, and the world was plunged into lament. A tattoo, too, can be the fruit of inadequacy thinking, something not even found among many of those called unbelievers.
Grace, peace and mercy.

title: The Adequate Christ in you
author: Precious Oluwadamilola Oluwasegun
excerpt: You will never be used of God if you constantly look at your inadequacy. Looking unto Jesus is what the Scriptures recommend.
body: You will never be used of God if you constantly look at your inadequacy. Looking unto Jesus is what the Scriptures recommend.
"You're useless," yes, accept the thought that you are. If a man tells you that you are miserable, never argue; you know you are more miserable than he thought.
But there is one truth he fails to tell you: you are more adequate than he thinks. The Adequate Christ dwells in you.
You can never make yourself into what God wants you to be, but you can trust Him to make you into what He wants of you.
As long as the people looked at the serpents biting them and thought of their own inability to overcome, they died. When they looked up to Jesus, they lived.

You may be told you are inadequate, and it is true. But is Christ adequate? More than. The gospel is enough to save. Don't let the thinking of inadequacy make you add to it what God never wanted there.
It is adequate, if God is pleased with it.
